Campaign.title: Campaign
Campaign.description: User-owned interactive text RPG campaign slot with world setup, hero name/gender, explicit numeric vitals, 4 hero skills, structured inventory, quest tracker, chapter archives, active NPC emotion, NPC relationships, and butterfly-effect timeline.

title.description: Display title of the RPG chronicle.

universe.description: Chosen universe (anime, book, series, game, or original world).

characterSummary.description: Player character role (canon, OC, or isekai), traits, and background.

playerName.description: Explicit hero display name used to lock narrative continuity.

playerGender.description: Explicit hero grammatical gender (male, female, neutral).

toneAndDifficulty.description: Atmosphere tone and harshness of consequences.

hudStatusAndInventory.description: Compact HUD condition and key items summary.

hudRelationsAndCanon.description: Compact HUD relations and canon impact summary.

canonDeviationPercent.description: Estimated butterfly-effect deviation from original canon (0 to 100).

healthPercent.description: Explicit numeric health percentage (0 to 100, or -1 for legacy fallback).

currencyLabel.description: Currency unit or formatted display label.

skills.description: 4 universal hero skills (might, stealth, insight, lore) rated 1-10.

activeNpc.description: Snapshot of the currently interacting NPC and their visible emotional state.

inventory.description: Legacy flat list of item names synced for backwards compatibility.

inventoryItems.description: Structured inventory items with id, name, category, quantity, isEquipped, description.

npcs.description: Bounded list of encountered NPC relationship snapshots including recentActions.

butterflyEvents.description: Bounded list of canon-altering butterfly effect milestones.

activeQuests.description: Legacy active quest titles synced for backwards compatibility.

quests.description: Structured quest entries with id, title, status (active/completed/failed), and updatedAtTurn.

storySummary.description: Rolling summary of the current narrative arc.

chapterSummaries.description: Compressed 10-turn chapter archive summaries for two-tier long-term memory.

CampaignTurn.title: CampaignTurn
CampaignTurn.description: Immutable narrative turn in an RPG campaign including player action, GM prose, HUD snapshot, active NPC emotion, branching choices, and stateSnapshot for rollback/forking.

playerAction.description: Action chosen or typed by the player before this turn.

hudLine.description: Formatted HUD line for this turn.

activeNpc.description: Interacting NPC emotion snapshot during this turn.

choices.description: 3-4 distinct branching choices offered at the end of this turn.

stateSnapshot.description: Campaign state snapshot captured at this turn for atomic rollback and timeline forking.

/users/{userId}/campaigns/{campaignId}.description: Per-user RPG campaign slots and live game state.

/users/{userId}/campaigns/{campaignId}/t.description: Ordered narrative turn history for a specific RPG campaign.
